svg.title: Voice Resale Compliance Before Launch
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-08-voice-resale-compliance-roadmap; chapter number: 12; title: Voice Resale Compliance Before Launch; subtitle: Four checks that decide whether traffic gets carried; chart type: timeline_roadmap; weeks: week: Week 1; title: Confirm your own RMD listing; deliverable: Robocall Mitigation Database listing and certification verified directly; gate: Do not trust the upstream carrier or lawyer; traffic from unlisted providers is refused as of May 28, 2024; week: Week 2; title: Verify attestation; deliverable: Call the 920-66-1392 checker from your own trunk; buy DIDs from the carrier that signs your calls; gate: Anything other than A attestation is fixed; week: Week 3; title: File state and tax obligations; deliverable: Filed in every state with billing and tax modeled; uncollectibles entered as positive numbers; gate: No launch until filings are complete; week: Week 4; title: Cap exposure and check margin; deliverable: Daily spend and per-minute caps on A-Z termination; USF pass-through at four to five dollars a bill; gate: Resale margin holds at 15 to 20 percent; caption: Compliance now decides who survives in voice resale, against a margin of only 15 to 20 percent.; assumptions note: Weekly sequencing is an editorial ordering of practitioner gates; Sangoma, ZCorum and Crosstalk disagree on reseller STIR/SHAKEN obligations.; note: Sources: Crosstalk Solutions (ycGPHG_ANrE), ZCorum (ZLzeR3N0mpc), Sangoma (3XJ9OkK8aFw), The Boon of Wireless (Gye5g8KT7Oo), Public Service Commission of Wisconsin (vH9VQq2V9Qw).
